issue.title: 3.7: Fix SmartyAds Criteo domain
issue.body_excerpt: Remove 'as.us.criteo.com' from smartyads; add a mapping test. detectPlatformFromUrl should map that host to criteo or null, not smartyads.

affected_files.role: add a mapping test that asserts detectPlatformFromUrl('https://as.us.criteo.com/...') returns 'criteo' or null

analysis.current_implementation: TRACKING_PLATFORMS.smartyads.domains in src/lib/pixel-detector.js (around line 502) contains: ['n1.smartyads.com', 'as.us.criteo.com', 'pixel.smartyads.com', 'dsp.smartyads.com']. The second entry is a Criteo CDN endpoint incorrectly attributed to SmartyAds. The pre-computed DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP (line 569-578) iterates the catalog and records the FIRST-encountered mapping per domain — since criteo is also defined in the catalog, the duplicate host is a 'smartyads wins' bug for that host because the criteo entry uses exact-match domains (e.g., 'static.criteo.net', 'dis.criteo.com') that won't match 'as.us.criteo.com' as a substring. The map is exact-key, not a longest-match — so as.us.criteo.com never matches a criteo entry but does match smartyads.
analysis.limitations: Misclassification: a request to as.us.criteo.com is reported as 'smartyads' in the dashboard, which is wrong; the host is a Criteo domain. The acceptance criterion explicitly states it should map to 'criteo or null'.
analysis.change_surface: 1 line removed in pixel-detector.js, plus a small test addition.
analysis.root_cause: Catalog error: TRACKING_PLATFORMS.smartyads.domains contains 'as.us.criteo.com', a Criteo CDN host. The literal-key map has no way to resolve this — only catalog hygiene fixes it.
analysis.failure_chain: Criteo CDN request at as.us.criteo.com -> DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP returns 'smartyads' (first match wins) -> dashboard shows wrong platform -> F-BUG-003

options.name: Remove the bogus host from smartyads
options.summary: Delete the string 'as.us.criteo.com' from smartyads.domains. Add a test that asserts detectPlatformFromUrl('https://as.us.criteo.com/x') does not return 'smartyads'.
pros: Acceptance criterion F-BUG-003 satisfied with a one-line diff
Catalog stays lean; no new mapping needed (the host no longer classifies as any platform, matching the spec's 'or null')
cons: If SmartyAds really did route through that Criteo host, this drops a real detection. (But the issue states it is a bug, so it does not.)
options.risk_details: Removing a single catalog string. Verify: `rg -n 'as.us.criteo.com' src/lib/pixel-detector.js` exits 1 after the change.

options_considered: Remove the bogus host from smartyads

history.note: Catalog errors rarely get commit-level history; the wrong host has been there since the catalog was authored.
